organizations.description: Google serves Gemini on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (formerly Vertex AI) from a global endpoint, which may process requests in any Google Cloud location, or from multi-region endpoints that keep processing within the United States or the European Union. It does not say which region serves a given request.

quotes: When you use jurisdictional endpoints, ML processing stays within that specific geographical region (such as the United States or the European Union).

The European Union multi-region (eu) endpoint strictly covers data residency within EU member states. Geographies outside the European Union political boundary, including the United Kingdom and Switzerland, are excluded from this endpoint.
Requests submitted to a global endpoint may be processed in any Google Cloud location around the world, and therefore don't provide any data residency guarantees.
Don't use the global endpoint if you have ML processing requirements, because you can't control or know which region your ML processing requests are sent to when a request is made.

Multi-region endpoints let you ensure that machine learning processing of Customer Data by the service stays within a specific jurisdictional boundary, such as the United States or the European Union.

organizations.description: Infomaniak states that its AI services run in its own data centers in Switzerland. Its AI Services pages do not say which facility serves which model.

quotes: Our AI and GPU services are powered from the heart of Europe in our data centers located in Switzerland, with no dependence on foreign players.

organizations.description: Mistral AI serves its models from a global endpoint, with no commitment to where a request runs, and from regional endpoints in the European Union and the United States. Its subprocessor list names the countries of its own infrastructure and of its inference provider, but not the buildings.

quotes: if you do not specify a region, the API uses the global Mistral endpoint.
Mistral does not commit to a specific inference location for requests sent to this endpoint.
Where do you store my data or my Organization's data?
By default, your data is hosted in the European Union.
